name: Kouzuki Kazuna
source:
A girl pursuing her dreams of acting in Tokyo. 

She can’t forget about her sister, who went missing five years ago. When she receives information about someone sighting her sister, she asks Shuugo to look for her, to her parents’ opposition.

Contrary to her dignified appearance, she possesses a bright and cheerful personality, and tends to cause chaos with her actions.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=116]MangaGamer[/url]]
